title: S06T03 - Add Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot, Windsurf, Roo/Cline, and Kiro adapters
description: Implement native instruction or skill placement, ignore rules, and capability-aware setup for the major agent clients without leaking configuration across repositories.
acceptanceCriteria: Each target has a documented install path, generated instructions, dry-run preview, idempotent update, clean uninstall, and doctor fixture.
Unsupported capabilities are reported explicitly instead of silently approximated.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
